SELECT employees.*, DATE_FORMAT(#{filter.date}, "%M/%Y") AS date, employees.code AS employeesCode, DATE_FORMAT(employees.start_working_date, "%d-%b-%y") AS dateOfWork, employees.num_month AS numOfMonth, employees.amount_deposit AS cashAmount, (SELECT name FROM positions WHERE id = employees.position_id) AS plateNumber FROM employees INNER JOIN payrolls ON payrolls.employee_id = employees.id AND payrolls.is_active = 1 INNER JOIN payroll_details ON payroll_details.payroll_id = payrolls.id AND payroll_details.is_active = 1 WHERE employees.is_active = 1
AND MONTH(payrolls.pay_date) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND YEAR(payrolls.pay_date) = YEAR(#{filter.date}) AND payroll_details.payroll_item_id = 5
AND employees.department_id IN (SELECT id FROM departments WHERE group_id = #{filter.groupId})
AND employees.department_id = #{filter.departmentId}
ORDER BY employees.position_id ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{filter.date}, "%M/%Y") AS year

SELECT * FROM departments WHERE is_active = 1 AND group_id = #{groupId} AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND is_provident_fund = 1 AND employees.id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(pay_date) = #{filter.date}))

SELECT YEAR(pay_date) AS year FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(pay_date) <= #{year} GROUP BY YEAR(pay_date)

SELECT YEAR(pay_date) AS date FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(pay_date) = #{year} GROUP BY YEAR(pay_date)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM provident_fund_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND status = 2 AND employee_id = #{employeesId} AND provident_fund_id IN (SELECT id FROM provident_funds WHERE is_active = 1 AND status = 2 AND Year(request_date) <= #{year})
